name: self-learning-agent
description: Turn creator videos into Obsidian notes and human-approved tool setup

plugins.name: self-learning-agent
plugins.description: Point it at a YouTube video or a channel and get an Obsidian note worth keeping, plus a short list of setup actions. Nothing installs without your explicit yes, and generated skills are security-scanned before they can activate. Channels are triaged from metadata first, so you pick what gets read.
